label: Кодекс на труда — nothing tabled or promulgated in the window
text: The bills feed shows no labour-related registration since 26 October and ДВ has issued nothing since ДВ бр. 99 of 30.10, so the only КТ-based instrument still moving is ПП № 235 under чл. 244, ал. 1, т. 1 КТ; КНСБ repeated on 3 November its demand for an across-the-board ≥10% budget-sector pay rise — a demand, not a filing.
